name: Non-Wilderness skeletons
accessNote: Non-Wilderness skeletons for Turael, Spria, and Mazchna tasks: the Edgeville Dungeon, Varrock Sewers, and Draynor/Wizards' Tower basements hold level 21/22 skeletons. Multicombat, cannon, and safespot status are not documented on the wiki and are left conservative (false).
